SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant (ICT Business Analyst – ANZSCO 261111)
Blu Pantera Tech Pty Ltd
Fortitude Valley, Brisbane QLD 4006
Full time
$140,000 – $180,000 per year + superannuation

About position
The SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant is responsible for analysing business requirements, and designing, configuring and implementing SAP EAM solutions that optimise asset management and maintenance processes for clients operating in asset-intensive industries. The role partners with business stakeholders to maximise asset reliability, reduce maintenance costs and support digital transformation through effective SAP EAM solutions, while ensuring project delivery meets quality standards, timelines and client requirements.

Responsibilities
- Consult with clients, users and stakeholders to understand organisational objectives, operational requirements and asset management needs.
- Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices to determine inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Define, document and validate functional requirements for SAP solutions supporting asset management and maintenance operations, and recommend process improvements and system enhancements.
- Design, configure and implement SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions aligned with operational requirements and industry best practice, including asset structures, functional locations, equipment records, maintenance notifications, work orders, preventive and corrective maintenance processes, maintenance plans and maintenance strategies.
- Develop functional specifications, data and process models, system documentation and process maps to support SAP solution design, configuration and development.
- Collaborate with technical consultants, developers and project teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.
- Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop project plans, estimate costs, allocate resources and manage SAP EAM implementation activities to achieve project milestones and deadlines.
- Develop and execute test plans, including unit, integration and user acceptance testing (UAT), and coordinate data migration, master data validation, system deployment and go-live activities.
- Prepare user documentation, business process documentation and training materials, and deliver formal training to end users.
- Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot functional issues and monitor SAP EAM processes and performance to identify improvements.
- Act as a central functional reference point throughout project delivery, liaising with clients, users, project managers, developers and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet requirements, quality standards and project objectives.

Skills and Qualifications required to perform the above job role
- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
- SAP certification or relevant SAP EAM/PM training is highly regarded.
- Minimum of 5 years' experience implementing and supporting SAP Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM/PM) solutions.
- Strong business analysis skills, with the ability to identify business requirements, analyse processes and develop functional specifications, process models, documentation and test plans.
- Experience in project management, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, and the ability to oversee the implementation of complex IT projects.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical teams, business stakeholders and end users.

Your insights and contributions will directly contribute to improving safety, enhancing operational efficiency, and driving profitability within our drilling operations. Train end-users on new reports and dashboards, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure a comprehensive understanding of the displayed information and its significance in supporting data-driven decision making.  Educate stakeholders on the meaning and context of the data presented, emphasizing how it can be leveraged to make informed business decisions. Provide project reporting, including activities, achievements, delays, and updates on a daily, weekly, fortnightly, and monthly basis.  Commission and decommission data sets.  Manage and design the reporting environment, including data sources, security, and metadata.  Assess and implement new or upgraded software, contributing to strategic decisions on new systems. Technical Skills:    Proficiency in Tableau and SQL is essential.  Undrestand Data modeling.  Python or R is good to know, but not essential.  dbt knowledge is a significant advantage.  Understand EDA.  Prior experience with SQL.  Demonstrated experience in handling large data sets and relational databases.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with advanced skills in Excel. A strong understanding of digital and data trends, with a passion for leveraging new technology to solve business problems.  Commercial mindset with a focus on operational efficiency. Job Description 

Fire Security AS is the sole manufacturer of the proprietary FireSec FS5 cable coating and specialists in life extension and rejuvenation of damaged electrical cables. Fire Security AS leads the way for fire protection engineering standards of electrical cables.

We have successfully applied our products, skills, and knowledge to upgrade electrical cables technically for oil and gas industry clients at many facilities around the world. We have extended the lifetime of electrical cables and lowered the risk exposure to our clients facilities, both offshore and onshore, substantially.

We are seeking applicants for full-time positions as Cable Repair & Fire Protection Engineering Technicians. The candidates should be familiar and have experience with Fire Security’s engineered cable repair solutions and products.

Responsibilities, tasks and duties:

-Conduct fire protection engineering on-site inspection to evaluate high risk areas where vital electrical and signal cables are routed (including industrial and engineering equipment, and electrical distribution systems on offshore oil and gas facilities).
-Assist in calculation of electrical cable repair and application cost (cost analysis).
-Produce detailed report including findings, detailed data on the density of electrical cables located in each location, the condition of the cables and identification of priority hazard areas.
-Repair, restore, maintain and upgrade damaged cables following FS repair procedures and engineering methodologies, in accordance with FS standards and procedures.
-Application of proprietary Fire Security engineered ablative FireSec FS5 cable coating following FS application procedures.
-Maintain and distribute daily reporting on QC, Progress and HSE.
-Work in a team on a 3-week roster offshore in Western Australia.

Positional requirements (qualifications, skills, work experience):

-IRATA Rope Access certified
-Experienced and certified for working offshore
-Experience with FS methodologies and products
-Experience with handling and repairing aging and UV degraded cables using FS products or similar
-Solid computer literacy
-Knowledge of electrical and signal cables routing connecting industrial and engineering equipment, and electrical distribution systems, particularly on offshore oil and gas facilities
-Familiarity with IEC-60331 (International Electrotechnical Commission) standards

Overview:

The Revenue Policy Analyst is responsible for the development of revenue policy and strategy within the newly established Revenue Strategy Unit (RS). This is a great opportunity for team members currently working within Local Health Networks (LHNs) to contribute to system-wide policy development and gain experience within the Department. 

The unit supports and manages key policy initiatives designed to support the optimisation of revenue outcomes for public health services. The unit's purpose is to provide system leadership, though policy and guidance to revenue-based teams working across the Local Health Networks, who are responsible for optimising revenue outcomes and meeting revenue compliance requirements. It achieves this through:

The development and maintenance of policies and guidelines (policy and governance).

Strategy, education, and business reform across all patient revenue streams.

The provision of a level 2 helpdesk, supporting Local Health Networks to get policy and practice right every time.

Commonwealth department and jurisdictional consultation and engagement on system wide issues-matters.

Periodic and ad hoc Revenue Compliance reviews.

The Revenue Policy Analyst will be involved in funding matters and audits and the provision of expert policy related advice to Local Health Networks (LHNs) to ensure that SA Health policies are implemented and adhered to.

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

result.description:
Job Description:
Kandui Group is a growing financial modelling / advisory firm based in Sydney, Australia. We work with founder-led organisations that are focused on improving margins, scalability and maintaining year-on-year consistency. We are committed to long-term partnerships and only providing solutions with measurable ROI’s.


As a Business Intelligence Developer, you will become the bridge between the technical world of data and the strategic needs of our clients. This is not your average developer or analyst role as you'll need to be a data expert, have an eye for beautiful dashboards and ultimately, be a champion of user-friendly insights.


Responsibilities:
Build clear and compelling dashboards for a diverse range of clientele to transform raw data into actionable insights.
Collate, transform and analyse data from varying sources.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate complex business problems into technical solutions.
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable SQL code as fluency in the language of data is a must.
Work with cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure to design and implement data solutions.
Apply architecture best practices to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and reliable.
Understand and implement integrations between cloud services and on-premise or third-party applications.
Stay ahead of the curve and explore new technologies and methodologies to keep our data game strong.


The right person will have:
Proficiency in SQL, data warehousing concepts, and ETL processes.
Demonstrable BI Dev / BA experience - understanding of key business concepts and the ability to translate them into technical solutions.
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or others.
Experience with automating ETL processes, reports, or data workflows to optimize and scale data operations.
Basic understanding of architecture best practices, including scalability, security, and reliability.
Exceptional communication skills which include being about to clearly explain complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to identify data challenges and develop effective solutions.
A passion for data and a desire to make an impact – you're excited to leverage data to drive business success.
Power BI experience essential.
Based in Sydney.


Behavioural:
Bring a positive, enthusiastic, "can-do" attitude to the office each day and help build-on the strong culture at Kandui Group.
Ability to meet deadlines and balance competing pressures.
Have an interest in understanding and adding value to the business.
Rigorous attention to detail.
Ability to work in [and enjoy] a team environment.
Strong appetite to come into the office everyday.
